editorial.blurb: Sāttvic serves an ever-changing daily thali experience that feels like eating at home, with warm hospitality and beautifully designed spaces that celebrate authentic Indian and Gujarati cuisine.
editorial.insiderTip: Check their Instagram for the daily menu before visiting—the thali changes each day, and starting with the Pani Puris is a crowd favorite. Ask your server to explain each dish; the staff loves sharing the story behind the food.

topDishes.note: absolutely delicious and the perfect way to start your meal
best in the Chicagoland area, served unlimited as part of thali
standout comfort dish with authentic flavor and warmth
